user.title: OBLO Living Cloud
user.description: Log in with your OBLO Living cloud account. Devices are picked up from the cloud automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate OBLO Living
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud session for {identity} expired or was rejected. Enter the password for this OBLO account to renew it.

error.invalid_auth: Cloud rejected these credentials (user does not exist or wrong password). Check the HA log for the exact error code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach cloud.oblo.rs (network error or rate limited).
error.cloud_unavailable: Reached cloud.oblo.rs but it answered with a server error (HTTP 5xx). The cloud service may be down.
error.unexpected_response: Login answered with an unexpected response. Check the HA log for details.
error.missing_credentials: Email and password are both required.
error.rate_limited: The cloud temporarily blocked this account after too many failed login attempts. Even the correct password fails until the block lifts - wait about 15 minutes, confirm the password in the OBLO app or at cloud.oblo.rs, then try once.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

set_property.name: Set OBLO property
set_property.description: Write one property to the gateway and confirm it by reading the value back. Raises if the gateway accepts the command but the value does not change, so a successful call means the device actually moved.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: OHM device id (the `id` field from the device list).

service_name.name: Service name
service_name.description: Instance alias from OHM, e.g. `outlet0` or `basic0`.

property_value.name: Value
property_value.description: Value to write. Relays take `1` (on) or `0` (off).

service_type.name: Service type
service_type.description: Canonical OHM class, e.g. `OutletService`. Sent alongside the alias so the gateway can address the service by class.

confirm_timeout.name: Confirmation timeout
confirm_timeout.description: Seconds to keep reading back before the write is called unconfirmed.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one OBLO entry is loaded.

get_property.name: Get OBLO property
get_property.description: Read one property straight from the gateway, bypassing the cached coordinator state. Use it to check a write independently.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: OHM device id (the `id` field from the device list).

service_name.name: Service name
service_name.description: Instance alias from OHM, e.g. `outlet0` or `basic0`.

service_type.name: Service type
service_type.description: Canonical OHM class, e.g. `OutletService`. Sent alongside the alias so the gateway can address the service by class.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one OBLO entry is loaded.

init.title: OBLO Living options
init.description: How often Home Assistant polls the OBLO cloud. Default {default} s, minimum {min} s. Live device changes arrive through the gateway event stream within milliseconds, so the poll only exists to catch missed events - a longer interval is gentler on the cloud API (each poll is three cloud round-trips).
